nodes.label: Deepslate Tiles Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of deepslate tiles. Dark charcoal-grey with a smaller, more uniform tile grid compared to deepslate bricks. Slightly shinier appearance with compact square tile divisions. Used for smooth dark tile flooring and walls in dungeon and castle aesthetics.
nodes.pattern: uniform small square tile grid with thin grout lines
nodes.game_purpose: refined deepslate tile block, used for dark tile flooring and polished dungeon surfaces
